response_limit_policy: 8192 completion tokens for global networks and 512 for per-person replies, including iterative initialization. The 50-person roster permits up to 49 IDs in a valid local reply. Abnormal finish reasons remain charged and stop collection; no partial answer is accepted.
global_retry_policy: Freeze all unambiguous valid roster ID pairs from the first rejected nonempty response. Format correction must return exactly that undirected friendship set without missing or new ties; malformed/unknown/self pairs are excluded. No illustrative numeric ID pairs are inserted into retry instructions. A wholly empty initial answer receives an explicitly labelled nonresponse retry within the same three-attempt limit; a nonempty answer with no recoverable pairs stops. Paid retries and failures remain recorded.
budget_policy: The author removed the historical $50 maximum. Every live scope still requires an explicit finite cumulative ceiling in its hash-bound review receipt; null is not permission for unlimited spending.
calibration_scope: Two generations for all seven settings and all four methods on GPT-6-Luna (56), plus one US-English generation per method on the other three models (12). This is engineering/cost calibration, not proof of adequate statistical power for all models.
estimand: Country-framing and instruction-language effects on a fixed synthetic roster; not national populations or country-language interactions.
roster_status: Designed fictional adult roster, ages 18-67, seed 224. Independently shuffled declared marginals; not census or population representative. No race labels or US parties. Political orientation is not universally equivalent across countries.
candidate_language: Fixed English JSON field names and values in all four instruction languages
primary_contrasts: Within method/model/repetition: other country framings versus US-English and other instruction languages versus US-English. Model pairs match method/country/language/repetition. Methods are whole protocols with different constraints.
uncertainty: Eight is the author-selected target, not a power guarantee. Preserve individual matched differences and report count, mean, sample standard deviation and range with explicit missingness. Calibration has only two repetitions on one model and cannot establish adequate precision across the panel. No significance declarations or independent-edge confidence intervals.
rq2_scope: Descriptive categorical homophily and numeric age assortativity. Compare each attribute with its own matched reference; do not rank unlike metrics or assert causal dominance.
translation_review: Independent AI-assisted English/Hindi/Japanese/Brazilian Portuguese instruction and retry review recorded in TRANSLATION_REVIEW.md; human bilingual signoff remains pending
astra_review: Author reports prior implementation reviewed; revised source hashes require fresh code review
replication_limit: Eight generations of one roster estimate within-roster variability, not between-roster uncertainty or general-population effects.
approval_gates: Code review and current prices verified before bounded calibration
Explicit calibration-only spending authorization and configured credential
Inspect actual token usage, parser outcomes, truncation and source/replay parity
Bilingual instruction/retry review before main study acceptance
Freeze contrasts and justify sample size or explicitly retain exploratory claims
